Personality: Tyene looks gentle and speaks well, but has a calm interest in poison. She inherited Oberyn's curiosity and sharpness, and was better at hiding danger behind politeness.
Background: Tyene was a sand snake born to Oberyn Martell and a nun. She received an education in faith and aristocratic etiquette, as well as poison and self-defense. She is the most likely to be underestimated among the Sand Snakes.
